sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XIII OF 2014
ACT XIII OF 2014
BALOCHISTAN ASSEMBLY MEMBERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES, AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 14th February, 2014]
No.PAB/Legis: V (14)/2014, dated
14-2-2014.---The Balochistan Assembly Members
(Salaries, Allowances, and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 2014. (Bill No.14 of
2014), having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 1st
February, 2014 and assented to by the Governor, Balochistan on 14th February,
2014 is hereby published as an Act of the Balochistan Provincial Assembly.
Preamble.---Whereas it is expedient further to amend the
Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) 1975, Act II
of 1975 in the manner hereinafter appearing:--
It is
hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries, Allowances and
Privileges) (Amendment) Act, 2014.
(2) It shall
come into force at onc

sections.description:
Amendment of Section 6 of Act II of 1975

ACT XIII OF 2014
ACT XIII OF 2014
BALOCHISTAN ASSEMBLY MEMBERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES, AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 14th February, 2014]
6. Amendment
of Section 6 of Act II of 1975.---In
the said Act, for Section 6, the following shall be substituted:--
Other facilities:--
A
member shall in addition to salary and allowances be entitled to:-
a. House
Rent Allowance @ rupees fifty thousand per month.
b. Utility
Allowance (Electricity and Gas) @ rupees twenty thousand per month.
c. Rupees
ten thousand per month as telephone charges.
d. Rupees
three thousand per day as conveyance allowance only during Assembly Session.
d. Discretionary
grant @ rupees twelve hundred thousand per annum.

sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Assembly Members Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 2014
sections.description:
Amendment of Section 7 of Act II of 1975

ACT XIII OF 2014
ACT XIII OF 2014
BALOCHISTAN ASSEMBLY MEMBERS (SALARIES, ALLOWANCES, AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2014
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Assembly Members (Salaries,
Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975.
[Gazette of Balochistan, Extraordinary, 14th February, 2014]
7. Amendment
of Section 7 of Act II of 1975.---In
the said Act, for the Section 7, the following shall be substituted:-
"Inclusive
of the salary, allowances and privileges admissible as Member, the Leader of
the Opposition shall be entitled to:--
(a) Consolidated
Salary of rupees ninety thousand per month.
(b) Free
official residence or upto rupees seventy thousand per month if residence is
rented or rupees fifty thousand per month if he resides in his own house.
(c) An
official vehicle maintained at Government expense.
(d) Sumptuary
Allowance @ twenty thousand rupees per month.
(e) Travel
by air in Business class.
(f) Free
Travel Allowance (F.T.A) of rupees five hundred thousand per annum in Travel
vouchers or Cash.
(g) Office
Telephone with no limit ceiling and residence upto rupees ten thousand per
month with official mobile SIM.
(h) The
Utility Bills (Gas and Electricity) of his residence shall be borne by
Government.
(i) Daily
Allowance @ rupees seven thousand per day.
(j) A sum
of rupees forty eight hundred thousand per annum shall be placed at his
disposal as Discretionary Grant.
(k) Services
of a whole time Senior Scale Stenographer and a Naib Qasid in the office"
